title: Reject oversized persisted Multi-Site collections before materialization

opportunity.rootCause: SitePersistenceCodec.FromRow could iterate and materialize oversized persisted arrays before later validation.
opportunity.risk: A malformed database row could increase per-Site allocation and parser work before runtime activation rejects the snapshot.

implementation.behavior: FromRow reuses the existing per-Site limits and fails closed before iteration for hostnames 32, path prefixes 64, upstreams 32, egress hosts 64, egress ports 32, and egress schemes 4.

red.result: failed 1/1 because oversized persisted collections produced no exception

verification.relatedRegression: passed 76/76 across configuration, editor, persistence, activation, security, health-trend, UI-contract, and handoff classes

boundary: Live PostgreSQL oversized-row execution and query-plan/latency benchmark were not available

Authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive/screen-reader verification, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified
